items.title: Albert Morgan Interview, 1958-08-19
items.q: Simon, later on when I got with Simon, he was the first one who started me to read him. Showed me how to bow bass.

ctx.x: It seems like just, oh, two or three years later, he was dead. Pretty sure, but in 1943 he died. Because that's when I met Lawrence in 1942. I would be glad to go.
Well, I do remember the first... This is why I say mention Simon, because he was the first man that I had in mind playing bass.
Do you remember their father, Billy?
